prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier and adding targeted sign-in hints or copy improved conversion, whereas placing sign-in late after adoption certificates severely hurt conversion.
Specific focused individual screens (Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro, Visibility Check) increased conversion, whereas multi-step setup flows consistently degraded it.
Select layout redesigns (Pick Friend stage/carousel, Story scroll/stage, Choose Path grid/carousel, Checklist intro) won, while photo upload redesigns and waiting screen spotlight redesigns hurt conversion.
Desktop interaction and activity hints won, whereas standalone headline updates, audio cues, progress bars, and tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for major winning features, forecasting negative or minimal gains (as low as -8.0%) for changes that delivered up to +14.0% improvements.
Predictions were too high for non-winning or failing changes, forecasting gains up to +12.0% on interventions that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] New Companion Desktop Behavior Preview Screen: Adds a dedicated preview screen before the home intro showing how the pet behaves on the desktop and how to hide or summon it. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Two-Column Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a side-by-side two-column view displaying pet personalities and visual traits clearly. (why: The adoption step has an 86.4% completion rate with users taking a median 89s, indicating decision friction when picking companion archetypes.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] New Companion Journey Intro Screen: Adds a new story onboarding screen introducing the pet companion journey before path selection. (why: The initial choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s, showing users need clearer context before choosing their setup path.)
3: [home, redesign] Checklist Layout Redesign for Waiting Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen into a structured checklist layout showing real-time background initialization steps. (why: The home stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s), and users report confusion when pets fail to appear immediately.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Re-login Pet Retrieval Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets will be restored automatically upon logging into their primary account. (why: Support received 8 emails last week reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Dock Controls Notification Prompt: Enables a ready prompt on the home intro screen showing how to access pet desktop tray controls. (why: Users report confusion after setup regarding how to manage, control, or hide their pet on the desktop.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Asset Pre-render Status Note: Displays detailed graphic pre-rendering status notes on the waiting screen while assets load. (why: Three support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop or app stall during initialization.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Buddy Interaction Modes Hint: Adds a hint on the story screen explaining how companions interact on top of desktop windows. (why: Improving initial understanding of desktop integration helps set expectations and boosts overall 53.5% completion rate.)

scores.note: Finish step has high dropoff (20%) and support inquiries match, but new screens require releases and offer modest gains.
Adoption stage redesigns consistently perform poorly (-5.6% average lift across 7 tests).
Adds context for high initial time, but introducing a new screen requires a full release.
Waiting screen spotlight/layout redesigns historically hurt conversion (-5.6%).
Sign-in hints consistently win (+1.8% over 10 tests) and directly target 8 recent support tickets.
Finish stage notification prompts show slight negative lift (-0.3%) in prior tests.
Home wait_info status notes reliably improve completion (+1.2% across 8 tests) with simple config.
Desktop interaction hints are proven winners (+2.8% on choose_path) and low cost.
